checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and all itemized prices are on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices.
The includesText names an arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits and authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
No second mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead appears in the items or disclosures.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the embalming price is on page 1, so it is on the same page.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service without viewing.
No D-alt-container disclosure is printed on the list, so there is no placement to evaluate.
No direct cremation item is listed, so the condition for this check is not met.
No direct cremation item is listed, so there is no direct cremation description to evaluate.
The list has no line items for direct cremation, immediate burial, or receiving remains, which are treated as expected items.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding is a required item and not a package.
No text asserts that a specific purchase is required by law, a cemetery, or a crematory beyond the prescribed disclosure wording.
No claim about delaying decomposition or protecting the body from gravesite substances appears.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure and no disclosure is printed in a way that is hard to notice.
